options.content: **07 · Mutual TLS.** The servers present a certificate signed by the demo CA, and so must the client: without one the handshake is refused. **direct** dials `dns:///server1:50051`; **xds** reaches the locator over TLS and secures the servers with its own credentials (client certificate included), checked against the authority `gemfire`. Fill the panels with `make select-load-test EX=07 SCRIPT=xds/balance` (both channels, 1 minute), or `SCRIPT=xds/failover` to also stop server1 at 40 s and start it at 80 s (annotated).

panels.title: direct: share of calls by transport security
panels.description: From each call's peer AuthInfo (demo_calls_total{security}): tls = the call's connection was TLS, with the client certificate accepted (the servers refuse a connection without one). "none" = the call never reached a server.

panels.title: xds: share of calls by transport security
panels.description: From each call's peer AuthInfo (demo_calls_total{security}): tls = the call's connection was TLS, with the client certificate accepted (the servers refuse a connection without one). "none" = the call never reached a server.

panels.title: Certificates expire in
panels.description: server1/server2: the certificate each presented on its last call (demo_server_cert_expiry_seconds). client: the certificate this client presents (demo_client_cert_expiry_seconds). The demo certificate is valid for 365 days; delete ./certs and restart to make new ones.

panels.title: Where the calls went (as in 05, now over mutual TLS)
direct: share of calls per server
panels.description: Not balanced: DNS gives one address, so every call goes to server1. Over the whole time range, from the client's interceptor (demo_calls_total), so a failover in the range shows up as "none" (calls that reached no server). Narrow the range to one run to see just that run.

panels.title: xds: share of calls per server
panels.description: Balanced: round robin over the servers the locator reported, so each gets half. During a failover the survivor takes everything until the other is back.

panels.title: direct: calls/s by server
panels.description: Each call's peer address, mapped to server1/server2. "none" means the call never reached a server (UNAVAILABLE). direct only ever reaches server1.

panels.title: xds: calls/s by server
panels.description: Each call's peer address, mapped to server1/server2. "none" means the call never reached a server (UNAVAILABLE). xds alternates between the servers, and moves everything to the survivor when one stops.

panels.title: gRPC connections per server
panels.description: GrpcServerStats.grpc.server.connections. It should read 2 on server1 (direct + xds) and 1 on server2, but with TLS it drifts down: every refused handshake (each demo run makes one attempt without a client certificate) subtracts 1 without ever adding it, so it can go negative. A bug in the extension's statistic, not real connections.

panels.title: Puts forwarded to the primary (/mtls)
panels.description: Balanced isn't partition-aware: round robin ignores which server owns a key. Every server holds a copy of every bucket here, so Gets are answered locally, but a Put must go to the bucket's primary, so about half are forwarded (PartitionedRegionStats.putRemoteCompleted).

panels.title: Members up
panels.description: Prometheus's scrape of each member: 1 = up. Shows when server1 is stopped.

panels.title: Failed calls/s by channel and code
panels.description: UNAVAILABLE while a channel has no server to send to: direct for as long as server1 is down, xds only for the calls in flight when it stopped.

panels.title: Failed requests (k6)
panels.description: Share of k6 requests that failed over the time range, for the runs in the "load run" dropdown.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(k6_http_reqs_total{client="grpc-go", run=~"$run", via="direct", expected_response="false"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(k6_http_reqs_total{client="grpc-go", run=~"$run", via="direct"}[$__range]))

(sum(increase(k6_http_reqs_total{client="grpc-go", run=~"$run", via="xds", expected_response="false"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(k6_http_reqs_total{client="grpc-go", run=~"$run", via="xds"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Performance (k6): not the point of this example
GemFire call p50 by channel
panels.description: Close once both servers are warm. On a fresh cluster xds starts slower: server2 never served gRPC before and its code is still being JIT-compiled.
